parameters.name: Domain
parameters.description: The name of the main streaming domain.

parameters.name: KeyWord
parameters.description: The keyword used in the query. You can specify the template ID or name. Fuzzy search is supported for the name.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of templates per page. Default value: 100.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live describe-live-stream-watermarks --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain live.yourdomain.com --key-word 445409ec-7eaa-461d-8f29-4bec2eb90000 --page-number 1 --page-size 100 --region cn-hangzhou
